options.description: A mark drawn at the start of every row, after the line number when there is one -- `'│ '` or `'> '`. Drawn muted, and never part of the value.
options.name: gutter

options.description: Says which stretches of the value are which tokens, for syntax highlighting.
options.name: highlight

options.description: The language the value is in, handed to `highlight` as its second argument -- `'ts'`, `'json'`, `'md'`. Nothing reads it but the highlighter.
options.name: lang

options.description: Numbers each line down the left. Two digits at the least, so the area does not move a column right at the tenth line; the caret's line is the one not muted.
options.name: lineNumbers

options.description: Called with the value after every edit that changed it. Not called for a write the app made.
options.name: onChange

options.description: Called with the selected text on a copy or a cut, which is where an app puts it on the clipboard -- `copyToClipboard(app.terminal, text)`.
options.name: onCopy

options.description: Shown, muted, while the value is empty.
options.name: placeholder

options.description: The host box's own props: a class, a margin, a `flex-grow`. Geometry only, never a colour.
options.name: props

options.description: The most rows the area asks for before it scrolls, growing into it as lines are added. Ten by default. A `flex-grow` or a `height` in `props` gives it more, and a column too short for it takes rows away.
options.name: rows

options.description: What Tab types -- `' '`, or `'\t'`, which draws as one column the way it does everywhere else in this library.
options.name: tab

options.description: How many columns the area takes, gutter included. Defaults to what the layout gives it -- the whole width in a column, and forty columns of text in a row, shrinking to its share where the row is short.
options.default: what the layout gives it -- the whole width in a column
options.name: width
